messages.content: How is the air quality in Los Angeles right now?

function.name: plant_biomass
function.description: Calculate the biomass of a plant species in a given area. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

species_name.description: The name of the plant species.

area.description: The area of the forest in square kilometers. This is a float type value.

message.content:
I don’t have live access to real‑time air‑quality data, but you can quickly check the current conditions in Los Angeles by visiting one of the following resources:

| Source | What it offers | How to use |
|--------|----------------|------------|
| **AirNow** (airnow.gov) | Real‑time AQI values, pollutant breakdowns, and forecast | Search “Los Angeles” or enter your ZIP code. |
| **EPA Air Quality Index** (aqicn.org) | Global map with AQI, health advice, and historical trends | Select the LA region on the map. |
| **Local news sites** (e.g., LA Times, CBS Los Angeles) | Daily updates, alerts, and health tips | Look for the “weather” or “environment” section. |
| **Weather apps** (Apple Weather, Google Weather, AccuWeather) | Integrated AQI widget | Enable the “Air Quality” setting in the app. |

If you’re looking for a quick snapshot right now, just type “Los Angeles air quality” into your search engine and the top result will usually show the current AQI and pollutant levels. If you need more detailed or historical data, the AirNow website or the EPA’s AQICN portal are the most reliable sources.
message.reasoning: User asks about current air quality in Los Angeles. We need to provide real-time data. We don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking AirNow or local sources. We can also provide general info. No function needed.
